review:
Anubis vs Hades on a 5x5 golden arena with 15 lines. When free spins trigger, you pick a side – and that choice really changes how the bonus plays.

Anubis is the steadier pick, with expanding wilds that stick until the end. Hades is the more aggressive option. Super scatters can also trigger Super Free Spins, which start with multipliers from 10x. Very high volatility, a 10,000x max and 96.5% RTP. Free spins about once every 313 spins.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus is rare (about 1 in 313 spins on average)
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
